title: This Biotech Has a June 30 FDA Catalyst. A Fund Just Cut Its Stake by $7 Million
author: Jonathan Ponciano
description: HighVista Strategies sold 238,243 shares of Viridian Therapeutics (worth ~$7.08 million) in Q1 2026, reducing its position by $8.97 million when accounting for stock price movements. The sale may reflect profit-taking ahead of the company's June 30 FDA decision on its lead therapy veligrotug. Despite recent stock volatility following Phase 3 data that beat expectations, Viridian remains positioned as a potential commercial player in the thyroid eye disease market with its subcutaneous candidate elegrobart.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed signals: stock up 35% over the past year and showing positive Phase 3 data for elegrobart, but recent 30% decline after Phase 3 TED data fell short of expectations. Fund reduction suggests profit-taking, but company maintains solid business momentum with June 30 FDA decision as key catalyst. Sentiment is neutral as the outcome depends heavily on upcoming FDA approval execution.

title: Kopp Family Office Trims $3.5 Million Worth of Viridian Therapeutics Stake -- What Investors Should Know
author: Andy Gould
description: Kopp Family Office reduced its Viridian Therapeutics stake by 117,878 shares ($3.5M) in Q1 2026, cutting the position from 3.4% to 0.7% of AUM. The move appears prescient as Viridian shares have fallen 50% since mid-March following disappointing Phase 3 data for elegrobart and stronger competing results from Amgen's Tepezza variant, raising questions about market differentiation for the clinical-stage biotech.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock has underperformed S&P 500 by 28 percentage points over the past year and fallen 50% since mid-March. Phase 3 data for elegrobart showed limited inflammation improvements and tinnitus concerns. Facing significant competitive pressure from Amgen's superior clinical results, raising questions about market differentiation and commercial viability.

Reported Phase 3 results for subcutaneous Tepezza showing 77% proptosis response rate, numerically superior to Viridian's elegrobart (54-63%), strengthening its competitive position in the thyroid eye disease market.

title: J.Jill, Inc. Shareholders Are Encouraged to Reach Out to Johnson Fistel for More Information About Potentially Recovering Their Losses
author: Johnson Fistel, Pllp
description: Johnson Fistel, PLLC is investigating potential securities fraud claims on behalf of investors in J.Jill, RH, and Viridian Therapeutics. The J.Jill investigation was prompted by the company's March 31, 2026 earnings disclosure revealing poor holiday assortment performance, increased competitive promotions, and customer migration toward discounted pricing, raising questions about compliance with federal securities laws.

title: Viridian Therapeutics Stock Up 75%, but One Fund Just Sold Off Its $69 Million Stake
author: Jonathan Ponciano
description: Commodore Capital completely exited its 3.2 million share position in Viridian Therapeutics (worth $69 million) on February 17, 2026, reducing the holding from 3.4% of the fund's assets to zero. This comes despite Viridian's stock being up 75% over the past year and entering a catalyst-heavy 2026 with FDA approval decisions and Phase 3 data expected. The exit suggests the fund may be taking profits after the strong rally or reallocating capital to other clinical-stage biotech names.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the stock is up 75% and has significant catalysts ahead (FDA approval decision and Phase 3 data), the major fund exit suggests valuation concerns or risk reassessment despite positive momentum. The mixed signals—strong performance offset by institutional selling—warrant a neutral stance.
Remains a significant holding at 6.6% of AUM ($99.33 million) and is mentioned as a comparable clinical-stage investment that Commodore maintained, suggesting confidence in the company.
Held at 5.9% of AUM ($88.73 million) as part of Commodore's concentrated clinical-stage biotech portfolio, indicating the fund's continued conviction in this name.
